fright_micro_state → fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction upward Frightened fish create frightened-frightened contact edges when they remain near other frightened fish; local episodes thus shape the fraction of frightened edges in a component.

fright_micro_state → fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr upward Frightened individuals may cluster toward component edges or interiors during escape, so individual fright occurrence contributes to the correlation between fright and distance from component centroid.

fright_micro_state → fright_macro_onset_rate upward Individual fish entering fright are the elementary state changes that drive the macro onset rate; local frightened fish can also trigger further onsets through social transmission.

fright_micro_remaining → fright_meso_component_prevalence upward Longer remaining fright keeps individuals frightened across more steps, increasing the fraction of frightened fish within their contact component.

fright_micro_remaining → fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr upward Prolonged fright changes where frightened fish are located relative to the component centroid, altering the spatial correlation of fright.
fright_micro_remaining → fright_macro_school_prevalence upward Individual fright duration controls how long fish remain counted as frightened, affecting whole-school fright prevalence.

fright_meso_component_prevalence → fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction intra_scale A higher fraction of frightened fish in a component increases the chance that within-component contact edges have both endpoints frightened.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_micro_state downward A high fraction of frightened contact edges in a component increases social fright exposure, making a focal fish's transition into fright more likely.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_micro_remaining downward Dense frightened-edge contexts can prolong or reset local fright pressure, plausibly affecting the remaining fright duration of a focal fish.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_meso_component_prevalence intra_scale Frightened-frightened edges reflect and can reinforce local fright clustering, raising component fright prevalence.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr intra_scale Fright edges concentrate frightened fish in contact cores, altering the relation between fright and centroid distance.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_macro_school_prevalence upward Components with many frightened-frightened edges can sustain local fright spread, which can raise the overall fraction of frightened fish school-wide.

fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr → fright_macro_school_prevalence upward Spatial clustering of fright within components affects how many fish become frightened overall, shaping school fright prevalence.

fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr → fright_macro_onset_rate upward When frightened fish are positioned near susceptible component members, new fright onsets can occur faster at the school level.

fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → fright_meso_component_prevalence downward A high global fraction of frightened edges indicates widespread fright contagion, which can raise the local prevalence of frightened fish within components through increased exposure.

fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale A high fraction of frightened-frightened contact edges can promote further social fright transmission, increasing whole-school fright prevalence.
fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → fright_macro_onset_rate intra_scale Frightened edges provide channels for new fright onsets, so higher frightened-edge fraction can raise the onset rate.
fright_macro_onset_rate → fright_micro_state downward A higher school-level onset rate increases local contagion pressure, making an individual fish's fright state more probable.

fright_macro_onset_rate → fright_meso_component_prevalence downward Higher school-wide fright onset introduces new frightened fish into local components, plausibly raising component fright prevalence.

fright_macro_onset_rate → fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction downward A rising onset rate increases the chance that both endpoints of a local contact become frightened, plausibly raising frightened-edge fractions.
fright_macro_onset_rate → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale New fright onsets add frightened fish and raise whole-school fright prevalence.
